story_info.title: Max Monkey and the Secret Castle
story_info.subtitle: A Jungle Quest for Confidence
story_info.moral: Being brave and trying your best helps you find wonderful things.

main_character.name: Max Monkey
main_character.appearance: Max is a small, energetic monkey with soft brown fur, a lighter tan face and belly, big curious eyes, and a long curling tail. He has an eager, wide-open smile.

slides.title: A Great Idea!
slides.text: Max Monkey loved the Adventure Jungle. "Adventure is waiting!" he cheered. Today, he wanted to find something special. He heard tales of a small, secret castle. It was hidden deep inside the jungle. Max decided to look for it. His big eyes looked all around. He wiggled his tail with joy. This was going to be a fun quest!
slides.speaker_notes: Max is excited to start his adventure in the Adventure Jungle, looking for a secret castle.

slides.title: Finding a Clue
slides.text: Max swung from vine to vine. He looked under big leaves. He peeked behind tall trees. "Where could the castle be?" he thought. Then, he saw something. A wall of very thick, green vines. They covered a big rock. Could the castle be behind them? Max felt a little flutter in his belly. He wanted to know!
slides.speaker_notes: Max discovers a wall of thick vines that might be hiding the castle, feeling a mix of excitement and curiosity.

slides.title: A Little Push
slides.text: The vines looked very old. They were tangled like big green ropes. Max tried to push them. They were too strong. "Oh, dear," Max said. He felt a little bit stuck. But then he remembered. Max is always brave! He looked closer. Maybe there was a tiny space he missed.
slides.speaker_notes: Max faces a challenge with the strong vines but remembers to be brave and look for another way.

slides.title: A Secret Way In
slides.text: Max saw a small opening! It was just big enough for him. He squeezed his body through the vines. It was dark for a moment. Then, sunlight shone in. Max blinked his big eyes. He was in a secret garden. And right in front of him, something special stood. It was very pretty!
slides.speaker_notes: Max finds a small opening and bravely squeezes through, discovering a secret garden.

slides.title: The Castle Found!
slides.text: It was not a huge castle. It was a beautiful stone formation! It looked like a tiny, old castle, covered in soft green moss. Max smiled a big, happy smile. He had found the secret! He felt brave and smart. Max knew he could do anything. "Adventure is always waiting!" he said. He felt calm and happy inside.
slides.speaker_notes: Max discovers the 'castle', a beautiful rock formation, and feels proud and confident about his adventure.
